description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Compiler' class for the SCSSPHP project. The class is responsible for parsing, compiling, and transforming SCSS source code into CSS, including handling features like extends, nesting, media queries, directives, source maps, and environment management. It serves as a central component of the SCSS compilation process in the project.

classes.name: Compiler
classes.description: This class implements the main compiler logic for transforming SCSS source code into CSS, managing parsing, environment contexts, handling directives, nested rules, extend logic, source maps, cache integration, and output formatting.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Deprecated method to compile SCSS code string into CSS; uses compileString internally.

methods.name: compileFile
methods.description: Compiles an SCSS file specified by path into CSS, returning a CompilationResult.

methods.name: compileString
methods.description: Main method that compiles SCSS source code into CSS, handling caching, parsing, environment setup, and output generation.

methods.name: getCompileOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of current compile options including import paths, registered variables and features, encoding, source map settings, and formatter.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a custom logger for the compiler.

methods.name: setErrorOuput
methods.description: Deprecated method to set an error output stream; use setLogger instead.

methods.name: parserFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Parser instance for a given file path.

methods.name: compileRoot
methods.description: Begins compilation process for the root block, flattening selectors and preparing the output tree.

methods.name: flattenSelectors
methods.description: Recursively processes nested selectors to produce flat CSS selectors.

methods.name: compileMedia
methods.description: Compiles media query blocks and their nested rules.

methods.name: compileDirective
methods.description: Processes directives such as @keyframes, @media, or @font-face within the SCSS.

methods.name: compileAtRoot
methods.description: Handles @at-root blocks, managing scope filtering based on with/without conditions.

methods.name: compileNestedBlock
methods.description: Compiles nested rule blocks, managing the environment stack and selector processing.

methods.name: compileBlock
methods.description: Compiles a generic block of SCSS, including its selectors and child rules.

methods.name: collapseSelectorsAsList
methods.description: Collapse nested selector arrays into a flattened list, handling combinators and conjunctions for proper CSS selector generation.

methods.name: replaceSelfSelector
methods.description: Replaces [self] placeholders within selectors with '&' or a provided replacement string, facilitating proper selector resolution during compilation.

methods.name: flattenSelectorSingle
methods.description: Joins adjacent classes and IDs within a selector segment to form a single flattened selector string, optimizing selector syntax.

methods.name: compileSelector
methods.description: Converts a selector array into a string suitable for CSS, assuming [self] has already been replaced.

methods.name: compileSelectorPart
methods.description: Processes individual parts of a selector, substituting [self] with '&' and compiling values accordingly.

methods.name: hasSelectorPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks whether a selector array contains a placeholder ('%'), indicating a dynamic or parameterized selector.

methods.name: pushCallStack
methods.description: Pushes the current method call onto the call stack for debugging and recursion detection; throws an error if a potential infinite loop is detected.

methods.name: popCallStack
methods.description: Removes the last call from the call stack after method execution.

methods.name: compileChildren
methods.description: Recursively compiles an array of child statements, managing call stack and returning early if a compilation result necessitates such.

methods.name: compileChildrenNoReturn
methods.description: Same as compileChildren but throws an error if a @return statement is encountered outside a function context.

methods.name: evaluateMediaQuery
methods.description: Evaluates media query expressions by parsing, reprocessing interpolations, and handling nested @media queries.

methods.name: compileMediaQuery
methods.description: Builds a media query string from a query list, merging types and expressions into a valid @media rule.

methods.name: mergeDirectRelationships
methods.description: Merges two selector lists considering combinators such as '+', '>', '~' to produce a relationship-aware combined selector list.

methods.name: mergeMediaTypes
methods.description: Attempts to merge two media type arrays, taking into account negation ('not') and incompatible types, returning null if impossible.

methods.name: compileImport
methods.description: Handles SCSS import statements, resolving file paths and importing external files as needed.

methods.name: compileImportPath
methods.description: Converts a raw import value into a normalized import path string suitable for filesystem access.

methods.name: escapeImportPathString
methods.description: Escapes spaces in import paths to ensure valid CSS import syntax.

methods.name: appendRootDirective
methods.description: Adds @import or @charset directives at the correct position in the source, maintaining comments and order.

methods.name: appendOutputLine
methods.description: Adds lines to output blocks, creating child blocks if necessary based on indentation and block types.

methods.name: compileChild
methods.description: Compiles a single child statement based on its type, managing scope, directives, rules, and control structures, and returning early on @return.

methods.name: expToString
methods.description: Converts an expression tree into a string representation, optionally including parentheses.

methods.name: isTruthy
methods.description: Evaluates whether a value should be considered true in conditionals, i.e., not null or false.

methods.name: isImmediateRelationshipCombinator
methods.description: Checks if a string represents an immediate CSS relationship combinator ('>', '+', '~').

methods.name: shouldEval
methods.description: Determines if an expression value should be evaluated, based on its type.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Recursively reduces expressions, performing calculations, evaluating variables, and simplifying structures to their base values.

methods.name: fncall
methods.description: Handles function call resolution, supporting SCSS functions, native PHP functions, and CSS functions.

methods.name: cssValidArg
methods.description: Validates arguments for CSS functions, ensuring proper types and formatting, returning false for invalid cases.

methods.name: stringifyFncallArgs
methods.description: Reformats function call arguments into string form suitable for CSS output, handling lists, expressions, and special functions.

methods.name: getFunctionReference
methods.description: Resolves references to functions, both user-defined SCSS functions and native PHP or CSS functions, providing metadata about the reference.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Converts method or function names by replacing hyphens with underscores for consistent internal handling.

methods.name: normalizeValue
methods.description: Normalizes complex values, handling lists, strings, and interpolation to ensure consistent internal representation.

methods.name: opAddNumberNumber
methods.description: Performs addition on two Number objects.

methods.name: opMulNumberNumber
methods.description: Performs multiplication on two Number objects.

methods.name: opSubNumberNumber
methods.description: Performs subtraction on two Number objects.

methods.name: opDivNumberNumber
methods.description: Performs division on two Number objects.

methods.name: opModNumberNumber
methods.description: Performs modulo operation on two Number objects.
